say:3:1120773001:1.text: We owe you our thanks, Chak. The Bestial Brawl was a roaring success.
say:3:1120773001:1.source_cn: 斗兽演祀能这么顺利地完成，真是多亏你了唷，奇克。

say:4:1120773002:1.text: The Dusk Lord will surely smile upon such a display of courage and strength. You've ensured his rest...
say:4:1120773002:1.source_cn: 残阳神欣赏到这样卓绝的技艺和出色的勇气，也一定会欣慰长眠……

say:5:1120773003:0.text: I'm just glad to be of some help.
say:5:1120773003:0.source_cn: 只要能帮到大家，我做的一切就值得了。

say:6:1120773004:1.text: Wounds caused by the loss of loved ones are slow to heal, but you and Rumon have done your best to make amends for deeds that were not wholly your fault. Now, you have helped the clan with a feat.
say:6:1120773004:1.source_cn: 虽然失去至亲的伤痛难以痊愈，但你和卢玛之前没有迫害族人...

say:7:1120773005:1.text: If you are truly determined to break away from the Quicksand Claws, know that here is a clan is willing to grant you a home.
say:7:1120773005:1.source_cn: 如果你们决心脱离流沙之爪，又没有想去的地方，我想，会有...

say:8:1120773006:1.text: While some may seem doubtful, if you give them time and sincerity, I believe you'll win the hearts of many.
say:8:1120773006:1.source_cn: 虽然可能还有一些族人比较顽固，但只要给他们一些时间，让...

say:9:1120773007:0.text: Chak! You did it! People don't hate us anymore!
say:9:1120773007:0.source_cn: 哇哦！太棒了，奇克！有人愿意相信我们了！

say:10:1120773008:0.text: Thank you, Chief, for giving us another chance.
say:10:1120773008:0.source_cn: 终于……谢谢你，族长，我们终于做出了一些改变。

say:11:1120773009:0.text: And thank you for your heartfelt words. Rumon and I will consider what comes next.
say:11:1120773009:0.source_cn: 也谢谢你的提议，我……我和卢玛，会考虑看看。
